description: Create a one-off payment invoice; the payer opens result.mini_app_invoice_url. See the invoices doc.

accepted_assets.description: Fiat mode: comma-separated assets the payer may pay in.

amount.description: Decimal string in MAJOR units, e.g. "5" = 5 USDT. Never a float. Required unless open_amount is true.

cancel_url.description: A «Return» link shown while the invoice is unpaid.

client_invoice_id.description: Your own id of the invoice (≤64, unique per app): a create that repeats it returns the existing invoice; `getInvoices {client_invoice_id}` finds it.

id.description: The buyer's id in your system.

hidden_message.description: Revealed to the payer ONLY after payment (≤2048).

max_payments.description: Multi-payment invoice (2..1000000): the link takes this many payments, each one its own invoice with `parent_invoice_id`; wallet payments only.

open_amount.description: Crypto mode only: the payer chooses the amount (donation) — pass true and NO amount.

payload.description: Opaque data echoed back in the webhook (≤4096).

rate_lock_seconds.description: Fiat mode: freeze crypto quotes for this long.

success_url.description: Short form of the paid button: a «Return» button to this link after the payment (not together with paid_btn_*).

swap_to.description: Auto-convert the received amount to this asset.

webhook_url.description: This operation's own https webhook address — its updates go there instead of the app's `webhook_url`.

name: createInvoice
